brief: The Manhattan Company tower with its mapped L-shaped base and asymmetric setbacks, great limestone street colonnades, buff-brick window piers, ornamental upper stories, four Gothic wall dormers, standing-seam green copper pyramid and octagonal spire.

nativeAxes.origin: Ground-level mapped plot center at bank street datum

sourceFacts.architect: H.Craig Severance, Yasuo Matsui and Shreve & Lamb

reconstruction.massing: Fresh thirty map ways: exact-QID L-shaped whole outline and twenty-nine parts, including signed rectangular roof. Mapped estimates retain unequal pavilions, courts and setbacks.
reconstruction.facade: LPC measured drawings and close exterior photographs establish the giant limestone colonnades, fluted piers, seventh-floor roundels, darker brick spandrels and contrasting upper terracotta decoration.
reconstruction.roof: Four standing-seam pyramid faces with small roof windows, two-story central Gothic wall dormers, parapet pinnacles and two-stage copper lantern are reconstructed from the LPC roof/spire photograph.

limitations: Original 431590-triangle, 39306480-byte detailed master remains exactly reproducible from the unchanged world-tower recipe. Reviewed source/four browser levels preserve L-shaped base, unequal Wall/Pine pavilions, mapped asymmetric setbacks and courts, limestone street colonnades, buff brick piers, darker spandrels, contrasting upper ornament, four Gothic wall dormers, turquoise copper pyramid and two-stage octagonal lantern/pole. Continuous facade backing and long piers replace independent window frames; district/street aggregate floors and skyline averages materials. Four dormers gain closed returns and the pyramid gains a top cap. Fine relief, replacement-window variations, copper seam pitch, and lantern section sizes are reconstructed. Original granite ground veneer uses a gray tint on the shared limestone graph in this medium-fi exterior. Published 927 ft sets the 282.5496 m envelope; LPC 71 floors and current owner 72 remain distinct. Three shared 256 px graphs, opaque glazing and zero images. Tenant lettering, moving flags, detailed doorway mechanisms, interiors/basement vaults, equipment and neighbouring buildings are excluded. 1.5 / 0.75 / 0.3 / 0.1 m shaft probe allowances exclude omitted fine relief/frames and distant facade subdivisions. No physical-device performance or surveyed grade claim.

geographic.notes: Fresh OSM API on 2026-10-10 confirms unchanged exact Q218305 whole outline 278042253 and twenty-nine separately retained mapped parts, including roof 286057109. Signed heading -0.668872591958 retained: native +X southeast, +Z southwest. Wall Street facade is +Z south/southwest; the longer Pine Street pavilion is -Z north/northeast. Shaft remains east of plot center. Roof rectangle supplies its signed copper-pyramid frame. Ground Y=0 is bank street datum. LPC Pine/Wall elevations and cadastral plan support these asymmetric sides. Mapped part heights are estimates rather than surveyed storey sections. Accept 2 m footprint / 1 degree reconstruction allowance; automatic footprint replacement disabled. Local slope and door thresholds are unmeasured.
